questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: To be part of a new environment with new people and discover a new culture. To improve my Spanish by being part of a sports organisation.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Mobility-online and all the administrative bureaucracy made my exchange experience sad and stressful. The management of the Erasmus students and the help with all the paperwork was non-existent. It's really hard when you come from a Nordic country where everything is in order with administration and digital and you go to Spain where everything is on paper and stone.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Not easy at all.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer:
non-assistance. My tutor in Spain was a German Professor and she thought I could speak German because I came from
Denmark.She
spoke to me in German and every time we met I had to tell her that I didn't speak German! I only saw her twice, for 5 minutes, to help me fill in the papers and my timetable.

How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: There was an Erasmus office that was only open once or twice a week and they didn't speak English. I know I was in Spain to improve my Spanish but it would be nice to have someone who speaks English when you've just arrived and you want all the bureaucracy done quickly. Because it's a nightmare. Moreover, everything is on paper and they have not discovered the beautiful things that digital tools can do.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Just sign papers

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I did after one month.. Again problem of the administration in my host university.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: good luck.

questions.answer: to eat so late.
